The water spirit commands the player to give/sustain life through water. Repeated အသက်ပေး can read as sacrificing one's own life in Myanmar; use causative အသက်ရှင်စေ consistently while preserving the clipped spirit voice and all clauses.

Current English says he waited too long and exited too quickly for his liking. Replace the awkward negative စိတ်ကြိုက် မဖြစ်လောက်အောင် construction with a direct too-soon-for-him comparison, preserving both temporal clauses and uncertainty.

The current original progress says bones of beasts once burdened by labor: former work animals. သားရဲ denotes wild/fierce beasts and adds the wrong animal category. Use neutral တိရစ္ဆာန် while retaining the past hard labor, bones, narrator voice and question about the water.

The spirit refers to the Shard of Water7813 and says take shard, give life, and protect/give life with water power. အစိတ်အပိုင်း commonly means component; အပိုင်းအစ preserves shard/fragment. Repeated အသက်ပေး commonly reads as sacrificing/giving one's own life; အသက်ရှင်သန်စေ makes the intended life-giving effect explicit. Preserve the clipped repetition, imperative sequence and final protective-water clause; do not add item UI or extra instructions.
